recent_articles.title: Govt. to soon bring in an AI policy to transform Bihar: CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** announced the state government's intention to introduce an AI policy, aiming to transform Bihar into an AI hub.  He highlighted the potential of AI in India's communication revolution and emphasized the importance of collaboration with younger generations. The summit, organized by the IT Department in collaboration with the **Bihar Industries Association (BIA)** and Qlass EdTech, saw participation from Deputy Chief Minister **Bijendra Prasad Yadav**, Information Technology Minister **Nitish Mishra**, and founder of BharatGPT **Ankush Agrawal**.

recent_articles.title: One month of Samrat Choudhary Government in Bihar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, the leader of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, took office as Chief Minister of Bihar on April 15, 2026.  He has implemented several initiatives focusing on development and combating corruption, including a blueprint for 11 satellite townships across 10 districts. The government also launched the "Police Didi Scheme" to enhance women's safety, established a three-tier public support system, and approved significant funding for education and infrastructure projects. Choudhary has also introduced measures to promote transparency in private schools and prioritize local contractors on civil projects.

recent_articles.title: Nazara Technologies shares soar 18% amid reports of Nikhil Kamath upping stake in block deal - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nazara Technologies** reported a significant increase in net profit for Q4FY26, driven by lower expenses and strong revenue growth in its gaming segment. The company's founder, **Nitish Mittersain**, is selling his stake in the company, while **Nikhil Kamath** of **Zerodha** and **Axana Estates** are among potential buyers.  The company also announced plans to acquire a controlling stake in a Spanish gaming studio for $100.3 million and invest in other companies within its core business segments of gaming, esports, and ad tech.

recent_articles.title: Nitish and BJP have no moral right to speak on dynastic politics, says Tejashwi Yadav - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tejashwi Yadav**, leader of the opposition in Bihar's Legislative Assembly, criticized **Nitish Kumar** and **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for their involvement in dynasty politics following the expansion of the **Bihar Cabinet**.  Yadav argued that both the **BJP** and its allies are engaging in dynasty politics, citing examples like the inclusion of sons of former Chief Ministers in the new cabinet.

recent_articles.title: Nitish Kumar’s son Nishant among 32 to take oath as Bihar Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nitish Kumar's** son, **Nishant Kumar**, and 30 others were sworn in as ministers in the Bihar government on Thursday.  The ceremony was attended by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**, Home Minister **Amit Shah**, and other senior leaders of the ruling NDA. **Samrat Choudhary**, who took over as Chief Minister after **Nitish Kumar** resigned, expanded his cabinet with former Deputy Chief Minister **Vijay Kumar Sinha**, and former Ministers **Shrawon Kumar** and **Ashok Choudhary**.  The oath-taking ceremony was presided over by Governor Lt. Gen. (Retd) Syed Ata Hasnain.

recent_articles.title: Nitish Kumar’s son Nishant Kumar may join Bihar cabinet on May 7 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nitish Kumar's** son, **Nishant Kumar**, is a subject of speculation regarding his potential inclusion in the new **Samrat Choudhary**-led NDA government cabinet.  Senior **JD(U)** leaders met with **Nitish Kumar** and held meetings in Patna ahead of the Cabinet expansion scheduled for Thursday. The event will be attended by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**, Union Home Minister **Narendra Modi**, BJP president **Nitin Nabin**, and other senior NDA leaders, but no official confirmation has been made regarding **Nishant Kumar's** inclusion.  The administration is preparing for the ceremony at Gandhi Maidan with security personnel, police dogs, and waterproof tents to ensure a smooth event despite weather warnings of hailstorms and rain.

recent_articles.title: Bihar Cabinet expansion on May 7, Modi, Shah and Nabin to attend event - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and **BJP president Nitin Nabin** will be present for the expansion of the **Bihar Cabinet** in Patna on Thursday, May 7, 2026.  The event is expected to feature most members from the previous Nitish Kumar-led NDA government retained, with a few new faces added to fill all 36 berths. The **BJP** aims for a "gala event" and preparations are underway at Gandhi Maidan. **Jitan Ram Manjhi**, leader of the HAM (S), has stated he will not demand a Cabinet berth and is content with whatever is offered.  The expansion is expected to include some new faces, potentially more women Ministers, and may see the return of several existing ministers from both the JD(U) and BJP.

recent_articles.title: Nishant launches Sadbhav Yatra from Bihar’s West Champaran - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nishant Kumar**, son of former Bihar Chief Minister **Nitish Kumar**, launched his 'Sadbhav Yatra' from Bagaha, following in his father's footsteps.  The young leader was accompanied by **Umesh Singh Kushwaha**, the **Bihar JD(U) president**, and **Shrawon Kumar**, the **JD-(U) Legislature Party leader**. He addressed supporters along the route, emphasizing harmony and development for Bihar. The journey is seen as a significant step in Nishant Kumar's political career, potentially bolstering the **JD(U)** after the resignation of his father.

recent_articles.title: Nishant launches Sadbhav Yatra from Bihar’s West Champaran - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nishant Kumar**, son of former Bihar Chief Minister **Nitish Kumar**, launched his "Sadbhav Yatra" from Bagaha in West Champaran district on Sunday, May 3, 2026.  The young leader was accompanied by **Umesh Singh Kushwaha**, the **Bihar JD(U)** president and **Shrawon Kumar**, the JD(U) Legislature Party leader. The yatra is seen as a significant step in Nishant Kumar's political career, following his father's long-held tradition of launching all yatras from Champaran.  He addressed supporters along the route, emphasizing the importance of harmony and development for Bihar.

recent_articles.title: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary proposes system where the children of Ministers and the poor study together - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, Bihar Chief Minister, visited Nalanda for the first time since assuming office on Friday. He praised former Chief Minister **Nitish Kumar**'s development work in Nalanda and across the state while highlighting that Bihar is progressing under the leadership of **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Nitish Kumar**.

recent_articles.title: Bihar govt removes Sanjay Gandhi's name from Patna zoo, dairy technology institute - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The BJP-led government in Bihar** renamed the Sanjay Gandhi Biological Park as 'Patna Zoo' and the Sanjay Gandhi Institute of Dairy Technology as 'Bihar State Institute of Dairy Technology'. The cabinet also approved ₹23,165 crore for a power subsidy scheme, ₹104 crore for degree colleges under the 'Saat Nischay-3' program, and land for a Centre of Excellence for autism treatment.  The government allocated funds for four major road projects, increased monthly stipends for SC/ST students in hostels, and approved the development of model schools with modern labs.

recent_articles.title: BJP-led NDA govt. in Bihar likely to see Cabinet expansion on May 6 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, the leader of the NDA government in Bihar, is planning a Cabinet expansion on May 6th.  The expansion is expected to include 16 Ministers each for the **Bharatiya Janata Party** and **Janata Dal (United)**, with smaller allies receiving four Ministers. The new Cabinet will likely feature many members from Nitish Kumar's previous administration.

recent_articles.title: BJP-led NDA govt. in Bihar likely to see Cabinet expansion on May 6 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, the leader of the NDA government in Bihar, is preparing for a Cabinet expansion on May 6th.  Speculation suggests that **Bharatiya Janata Party** and **Janata Dal (United)** will each appoint 16 Ministers, while smaller allies will receive four. The expansion may include many familiar faces from Nitish Kumar's previous cabinet due to the Constitutional limit of a maximum of 36 ministers in the state.
